Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the junior software developer position. My background aligns directly with your need for Python, SQL, React, and Flask expertise. During my internship at Example Labs, I built a Flask API and reduced response time by 30% through query optimization. Additionally, I developed an accessible Campus Dashboard using React, Python, and SQL, ensuring the project included automated tests from the start.

My education is currently underway as a BTech Computer Science student at Example University, expected to graduate in 2026. I am eager to collaborate with your engineering team to design robust REST APIs and optimize database performance for accessible dashboards.

I look forward to discussing how my foundational experience supports your technical goals.

Sincerely,
Robin Example
